tasks.label: tachyon: build-dev-host
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; WF="${workspaceFolder}"; HOST="$WF"; if [ -f "$WF/.git" ]; then COMMON="$(git -C "$WF" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "${COMMON:-}" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$COMMON")/package.json" ]; then HOST="$(dirname "$COMMON")"; fi; fi; BASE="$HOST/.tachyon/dev-host"; SLOT="${TACHYON_DEV_HOST_SLOT:-}"; if [ -n "$SLOT" ]; then PTR="$BASE/slots/$SLOT"; elif [ -L "$BASE/active" ]; then TARGET="$(readlink "$BASE/active")"; case "$TARGET" in /*) PTR="$TARGET" ;; *) PTR="$BASE/$TARGET" ;; esac; elif [ -e "$BASE/slots/default/extension" ]; then PTR="$BASE/slots/default"; elif [ -e "$BASE/extension" ]; then PTR="$BASE"; else echo "Tachyon Dev Host is not armed under the F5 host repo:" >&2; echo "  host: $HOST" >&2; echo "  missing: $BASE/active or slots/*/extension" >&2; echo "Multi-slot (t-efe06d): each owner arms slots/<id>/; F5 default uses active → slots/<id>." >&2; echo "Arm from monorepo or any linked worktree:" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point --worktree <feature-wt> --fixture <slug> [--owner NAME]" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point-status --all" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -e "$PTR/extension" ]; then echo "Tachyon Dev Host slot is not armed:" >&2; echo "  host: $HOST" >&2; echo "  slot path: $PTR" >&2; echo "  missing: $PTR/extension" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point-status --all" >&2; exit 1; fi; EXT="$(cd "$PTR/extension" && pwd -P)"; NM_SRC="$HOST/node_modules"; if [ ! -d "$NM_SRC" ] && [ -d "$WF/node_modules" ]; then NM_SRC="$WF/node_modules"; fi; test -d "$EXT/node_modules" || ln -sfn "$NM_SRC" "$EXT/node_modules"; TACHYON_ENGINE_CHANNEL=dev npm run build --prefix "$EXT"
